claims.statement: In 1869 McCoole beat Tom Allen in America for the championship of the world, according to Sullivan's memoir.
claims.excerpt: Coole beat Tom Allen in this country

claims.statement: In 1870 Jem Mace beat Tom Allen for the title and $5000 at Orleans, according to Sullivan's memoir.
Tom Allen beat McCoole on 23 September 1873 at Chouteau Island, near St. Louis, according to Sullivan's memoir.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen beat McCoole on Sept. 23,

claims.statement: Ben Hogan fought Tom Allen on 18 November 1873 for $2000 and the championship of the Pacific coast; Allen was winning when a wrangle broke up the fight.
claims.excerpt: on Noy. 18, same year, Ben Hogan

claims.statement: Joe Goss fought Tom Allen on 7 September 1876 (printed as 1976) for $2900 and the championship of the world in Kentucky; Goss was declared winner.

fights.excerpt: Coole beat Tom Allen in this country
fights.notes: Place given only as 'in this country' (America). Printed as 'Mc-' / 'Coole' across a line break.
Place printed as 'Orleans' only. Hint's 'Keanville (Kennerville)' is not confirmed by the OCR.

fights.excerpt: Tom Allen beat McCoole on Sept. 23,

fights.stakes: $2000 and the championship of the Pacific coast
fights.excerpt: on Noy. 18, same year, Ben Hogan
fights.notes: Allen was winning when a wrangle broke up the fight; no decision is given.

fights.notes: Year printed as 1976 (read as 1876, low confidence). Hint's $2,000 is wrong; the text says $2900.

notes: A memoir about who held the title; Allen appears only in the fight list. A garbled passage ('Allen fought Keanville, New ...') could not be read reliably and is not extracted. The Sullivan letter and other fights are not about Allen.
